For acceptance testing it is sometimes necessary to modify the configuration at runtime. The changes are not persisted.
The returned object makes it easy to restore the original value. Currently only string configurations are supported but that is easy to expand (by changing to a JToken).
 If the caller forgets (or dies) to set the configuration back the behaviour of the system will have changed until next restart.
